new_test.name: kip848_broker_heartbeat_interval_scheduling
asserts: Broker-directed multi-second interval (5000ms) on join schedules next consumer-protocol heartbeat at ~5000ms deadline, proving client no longer defaults to a 150ms loop
Subsequent broker response changing interval (60ms to 4000ms) is applied dynamically and moves next heartbeat deadline to ~4000ms
Invalid intervals (<= 0) on join are rejected with Error::Protocol
Invalid intervals (<= 0) on subsequent responses are safely classified into hb_err without spinning in a hot loop
Classic group heartbeat timing is unchanged (remains default 150ms interval from ConsumerConfig)
Prompt leave/close cancels heartbeat task immediately (< 500ms) without waiting for 5000ms interval
Prompt max-poll expiration leaves group promptly (< 2s) without sleeping through 5000ms heartbeat interval

limits: Share groups (KIP-932) heartbeats are unchanged (KL03-13 is a separate card).
In-memory mock broker test; live multi-broker cluster was not exercised.
